title: Cinematic Developer Hero
summary: 极简开发者首屏，中央视觉主体与可编辑 DOM 文案分层。
prompt:
Build a premium Cinematic Developer Hero for an AI-native front-end engineer portfolio.

Visual direction: floating browser shell with code-to-product transformation. Keep the composition editorial, spacious and recruiter-friendly.

Motion direction: scroll scrubs the visual from abstract code blocks into a finished interface. Use explicit scene states instead of unrelated looping decoration.

Use Vue 3 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS. Use GSAP only for timeline or scroll coordination that CSS cannot express cleanly.

Keep all headline, navigation and body copy as real editable DOM text. Do not bake text into video, canvas or images.

Respect prefers-reduced-motion. On touch or low-end devices, reduce pointer tracking and continuous effects.

Use one light presentation mode with #2563EB as the primary accent. Avoid generic purple-gradient AI styling.

Preserve keyboard focus, semantic HTML, readable contrast and stable layout. Motion may enhance hierarchy but must not block content.

Do not add decorative effects that lack product meaning. Every moving element must communicate state, depth, workflow or interaction.
